V0.1.08.description:
# Lost Kingdoms 2 AP Release V0.1.08

## New Features
- Added Enemysanity Plus (which adds another 405 enemies from the Proving Grounds as checks).
- Added the level randomization mapping to the slot data
## Bug Fixes
- Unicorn is now a progressive. Added logic for checks unicorn can make
- Fixed logic to account for jumping to get across the gap in Kendarie Fortress
- Swapped the Kendarie Soldier location names to be more accurate(maybe)
- Fixed logic for the jump chest at the start of Sarvan
- Fixed logic for the jump chest in Ruldo Forest(it now expects flight, but you can OoL it with long jumpers)
- Fixed a lot of logic for Krasheen Mountains locations
- Fixed the logic for the red fairies in Bhashea High Road to account for jumping
- Marked the 3 garbage collection checks for Kadishu until I can figure out the bug with them in level randomization.
- Added logic for progressive attributes+Sacred Battle Arena
- Fixed the stone of sealing not working.(Maybe)

V0.2.00.description:
# Lost Kingdoms 2 AP Release V0.2.00
 
## New Features
- Enemy randomization! (Experimental; play at your own risk)
- Music Randomization (courtesy of culk)
- Model Choice (courtesy of culk)
- Now opening a chest will state you collected an AP item, instead of japanese text
## Bug Fixes
- You can now fight the final guard in Kendarie Fortress
- You can now open the gate in Plains of Rowahl without having defeated the Kendarie Soldier
- You can now use the Mysterious Key without having beaten Nobleman's Residence.
## Notes
- A lot of stuff was rewritten on the backend, some from scratch. So new bugs may exist that I haven't caught. I encourage you all to report anything that you notice is wrong.
- Enemy Randomization was extremely complex to code, and as such has some equally complex bugs. Crashes may happen, so if you play it, save often.
- Enemy Randomization currently has 0 tuning, scaling, or curation. So it's currently possible, although unlikely, for you to physically be took weak to progress. (Usually just if you start with a bad deck and get a very difficult boss in the first level).
- I did lean on AI pretty hard for the enemy randomization, and as such I must make an exclaimer. This will probably get buried, but I plan to properly use Github soon, and I'll include it there.
- A big thanks to everyone who is cheering me on, it really means a lot! I'm expecting these rewrites to let me release many features a lot quicker. I hope you all enjoy.
V0.2.00.title: Lost Kingdoms 2 AP Release V0.2.00

V0.2.12.description:
## Bug Fixes
- Fixed an issue where you could not get the mysterious key check from Gurd if you possessed the mysterious key.(again ¯\_(ツ)_/¯)
- Fixed an issue where you could not get the blade of skill check if you possessed the blade of skill.
- Fixed an issue where many of the cards in the Cathedral Card Shop were not randomized when randomize shops was enabled.
- Fixed some of the descriptions for the new randomization options in the yaml
- Previously when enemysanity was enabled, enemies that already had checks associated with them would not trigger enemysanity checks; they now do. 
- In addition to the above, added 8 new enemysanity checks that were previously missed.
- The vanilla ways to get the God of Destruction and Birdman cards are now disabled, and gives checks instead.
- Fixed a minor issue with the location "Enemysanity - TriBlaster"
- Fixed an issue where enemysanity/levels as items would result in a mismatch in the item/location count.
